title: Ukrainian Hearty Beef Pilaf
description: A hearty, comforting pilaf dish from Ukraine, made with tender beef and flavorful spices.

ingredients.name: Ground Beef
ingredients.notes: 80/20 or higher lean to fat ratio

instructions: Heat butter in a large saucepan over medium-high heat.
Add ground beef and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add caraway seeds (if using), salt, and black pepper. Cook for 1 minute.
Add pilaf rice and stir to coat with butter and oil.
Add vegetable broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until rice is tender and liquid has been absorbed.
Fluff pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
